mil7.3.5:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, nāvāya tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti.
mil7.3.5:1.2: Yathā mahārāja nāvā bahuvidha-dāru-sanghāṭa-samavāyena bahum-pi janaṃ tārayati,
mil7.3.5:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ācāra-sīla-guṇa-vattapaṭivatta-bahuvidhadhamma-sanghāṭa-samavāyena sadevako loko tārayitabbo.
mil7.3.5:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja nāvāya paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.5:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja nāvā bahuvidha-ūmi-tthanita-vega-visaṭa-m-āvaṭṭavegaṃ sahati,
mil7.3.5:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena bahuvidha-kiles-ūmi-vegaṃ lābhasakkāra-yasasiloka-pūjanavandanā parakulesu nindāpasaṃsā sukhadukkha-sammānanavimānana-bahuvidhadosa-ūmivegañ-ca sahitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.5:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja nāvāya dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.5:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja nāvā aparimita-m-ananta-m-apāram-akkhobhita-gambhīre mahatimahāghose timi-timingalamakara-maccha-gaṇākule mahatimahāsamudde carati,
mil7.3.5:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena tiparivaṭṭadvādasākāra-catusaccābhisamaya-paṭivedhe mānasaṃ sañcārayitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.5:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja nāvāya tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.5:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Saṃyuttanikāyavare Saccasaṃyutte:
mil7.3.5:4.1: Vitakkentā ca kho tumhe bhikkhave: idaṃ dukkhan-ti vitakkeyyātha, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti vitakkeyyātha, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti vitakkeyyātha, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti vitakkeyyāthāti.
